race.comment: ZENACITY (3) had been building to a win before breaking through last time out, lifting to score by a head over 1200m at Strathalbyn. Winning hoop in Holder stays aboard and can keep the ball rolling now. TERRITORIAN (4) is usually thereabouts but finds it hard to win. Has been solid in his last two and has been kept up to the mark with a jumpout three weeks between runs. Up to this. SHALHAVMUSIK (9) hasn't quite met expectations in her two runs back but is worth one more chance as she steps to a winning trip. Will be hoping they overdo it in front so she can launch late. ALLEGEDLY (7) is going a bit better than his form reads and strikes a more suitable assignment. Pannell's booking adds confidence. Not dismissing.
